description: TypeScript 7 waits for its tooling: typescript-eslint (also behind eslint-config-next) refuses to run on it (typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940) and @astrojs/check only accepts 5 or 6, so the major fails lint or can't resolve its lockfile.
Only repos still on 6 or older are held (matched on the locked version); a repo already on 7 keeps its updates. Remove this rule once typescript-eslint supports 7.
